summary: 67-year-old Denver man died of an apparent medical condition at the Ute Canyon overlook on Colorado National Monument while riding alone in the Tour of the Moon event; spotted Saturday after he lost consciousness; a bystander and an off-duty paramedic attempted resuscitation; Mesa County Coroner's Office investigating cause of death
location: Ute Canyon overlook, Colorado National Monument
responding_agency: National Park Service (Mesa County Coroner's Office investigating)
notes: Date from article text (spotted Saturday; 2015-10-03 was Saturday — verified); fills Mesa's zero-row year 2015; body-discovery row per index precedent (id 3135)
